newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangzhou Shipyard wins contracts worth $200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Shipyard wins contracts worth $200 mln.

text.p: Guangzhou Shipyard International Co has won new contracts worth more than $200 million to build eight vessels for Iran and Denmark, a company statement said on Thursday.

Guangzhou Shipyard would build five vessels with a deadweight of 22,600 tonnes each for Iran's State Shipping Co and three 35,000 tonnes tankers for Danish oil and shipping group A.P. Moeller, the statement said.
A.P. Moeller will decide later this year whether to order another three tankers from Guangzhou Shipyard, it said.
Guangzhou Shipyard has been contracted to build and export 18 ships worth more than $400 million, it said, but gave no further details.
